paragraphs.text: Aerophin (sometimes referred to as aerophuis ) were artificial creatures created as servants of the Vedalken of Lumengrid prior to the plane becoming New Phyrexia .

The Aerophin were artificial creatures with a translucent sphere for a head and a dolphin-like body. They fly fast and can emit a powerful energy bolt of energy from their bubble-shaped head. The Vedalken often sent them to do their remote dirty work as they are fast, light, aggressive, and can travel great distances quickly.
